text:
oliver_sales: Heads-up: prospect Pelagic Clinics wants to run a 3-week POC on our Dedicated offering using their vendor model Nimbus-40b (custom variant nimbus-v2). They asked about tokenization parity, KV layout compatibility, and whether our runtime supports their mixed int3/int8 quant profile. Can eng run a quick compatibility triage?

jamal_platform: short answer: we can usually handle mixed quant but it's touchy. Key checks: tokenizer mapping, kv interleave vs linear, and whether their attention layout uses rotary embeddings vs standard. If rotary, need kernel checks.

catalog-bot: scheduled compat-scan for nimbus-40b@nimbus-v2 (scan id 90177). ETA ~18m.

tess_re: From pre-sales: Pelagic will want Private deploy with customer-managed KMS, and they require PI redaction in traces. Also they use a custom tokenizer that appends a domain-specific prefix token per record. Ask for a 500-sample token id dump.

anya_security: I'll flag PI redaction. If they want traces off we can enable privacy-mode but lose per-token cost telemetry during POC. Also need to know their key rotation window; if <7 days we may need extra KMS automation work.

jamal_platform: compatibility scanner command we use locally:
```
rwdctl compat run --model nimbus-40b --variant nimbus-v2 --checks=tokenizer,kv,kernels,quant,attn --out=90177.json
```
Expected pass snippet:
```
kv: OK (interleaved v2)
tokenizer: WARN (custom prefix tokens)
kernels: OK (cuda8, avx512)
quant: WARN (mixed int3/int8 requires shim)
attn: OK (rotary supported)
```
If tokenizer returns WARN we either onboard their tokenizer to the catalog or map prefixes at the preprocess layer.

catalog-bot: scan 90177 finished: kv=OK, tokenizer=NEEDS-MAPPING, kernels=OK, quant=CAUTION. Report: https://internal.redwood/compat/reports/90177

oliver_sales: Pelagic asked for a rough POC estimate and a short timeline. Can someone give a ballpark and blockers?

jamal_platform: Ballpark for a 3-week POC (dedicated small pool + private infra + engineering work to add tokenizer mapping + quant shim): $35k-$55k. Timeline: compat fixes + tokenizer mapping (2-4 business days if they provide token dump), quant shim dev + test (3 business days), KMS integration 5-10 business days depending on certs. If they want FIPS validation add 10 business days.

anya_security: Action item: Oliver attach their security questionnaire and token dump to the secure channel. I'll review KMS questions and privacy constraints.

tess_re: For catalog metadata, recommend adding fields: tokenizer_notes, kv_variant, quant_constraints, attn_family, canary_recommendation. That helps sales decide fallback.

jamal_platform: I'll update the catalog entry on green with these fields. Proposed snippet to add if they accept tokenizer mapping:
```
model_id: nimbus-40b
variant: nimbus-v2
kv_variant: interleaved-v2
tokenizer_family: "custom-prefix-bpe"
tokenizer_notes: "requires prefix mapping or onboarded tokenizer file"
quant_constraints: "mixed-int3/int8 - requires runtime shim (perf delta ~5-12%)"
attn_family: "rotary"
canary_recommendation: "5% traffic -> monitor p95 and perf vs open-40b"
```

catalog-bot: catalog draft created (pending review) at https://internal.redwood/catalog/drafts/nimbus-40b-nimbus-v2

oliver_sales: I'll get the token dump + SQ uploaded today. Keep me posted on whether we need to onboard tokenizer or if preprocessing mapping is sufficient.

jamal_platform: Quick note: if preprocessing mapping is used, ask Pelagic whether they can guarantee the prefix token is stable across training runs. If it's unstable we must onboard tokenizer to avoid drift.

anya_security: Also confirm data retention for POC. If Pelagic requires no retention, we need to enable ephemeral logs and document that in the SOW.

oliver_sales: Copy. I'll log action items and update the RFP. Thanks all.
